_about: Outgrow in one of the user's own cities (read-only: the save is loaded, never saved or deleted; the user, 22 Oct: stutters in a city of 15 000 with every building outgrown, gone the moment Outgrow is paused; and gardens grown into streets). The city runs at speed 1 for 45 s with Outgrow on, 45 s more, 45 s paused, and 30 s at speed 3 with Outgrow on (outgrowFrames: every frame's time with what Outgrow did around it, the garbage collector, the worst frames); then every garden is checked against the road, path and track surfaces (outgrowCheck, box gardens: gardens over roads, with close-ups). Run with Send-Suite -Fresh -Build; change 'name' for another city.
